plugins.name: constructing-software-stepwise
plugins.description: Stepwise refinement for hard designs: one node per approval cycle, one-question-at-a-time interview, contract-preserving decomposition, ADR-gated decisions, evidence-backed verification; Dijkstra-style pseudocode refined until terminal nodes adapt to the real thing (language, framework, platform, service), DESIGN.md holding the assembled program with approved nodes reused as procedures; typed ledger.json written only through the bundled stdlib CLI (new / set / body / answer / terminal / approve / reopen / stale / supersede / evidence / entry / change / meta / ambiguity / adr) which renders DESIGN.md, CONTEXT.md and node views and lints every write, so the agent writes only reasoning
